ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 30% high-intensity white pixels localized at the lateral extremities against a 70% low-intensity black pixel background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct contiguous white pigmentation zones located at the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe white patch originates at the tip and extends approximately one-third toward the center. The right lobe white patch is larger, occupying the outer distal third and containing vertical low-intensity striations. The central region is a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys. A prominent large-scale jagged excision is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature beginning at the median notch and extending to slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white circular pixel groups located on the extreme superior-lateral tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions crossing the white pigmentation field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic notch or indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible white scarring/barnacle attachment sites on the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'shredded' pixel profile on the extreme lateral edges of both lobes.
